'''Orn Kios''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] situated in the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to a populace known as the [[Ornki]] that practiced [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] and lived in lightweight structures built atop giant [[Lily pad/Legends|lily pads]]. During the early stages of the [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region which eventually included the Yarith [[Sector/Legends|sector]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] launched from worlds such as Orn Kios in search of new local [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]. To the Ornki's resentment, Orn Kios eventually became a tourist attraction.

==Description==
Orn Kios was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GG" /> located in the [[Orn Kios system/Legends|Orn Kios system]], a part of the [[Yarith sector/Legends|Yarith sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which connected it to the [[Darlyn Boda system/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] and [[Ozu system/Legends|Ozu systems]] of the neighboring [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> The surface of Orn Kios featured [[Water/Legends|water]], and its lifeforms included [[Fish/Legends|fish]] as well as colossal [[Lily pad/Legends|lily pads]].<ref name="GG" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]]. There, launching from newly [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] worlds such as Orn Kios, Republic [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] unsuccessfully attempted to discover shortcut [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] through the region's [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]]&mdash;the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax]] and [[Kiax Nebula/Legends|Kiax Nebulae]]&mdash;that would better connect the civilizations of the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]] and [[Nothoiin/Legends|Nothoiins]] to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="GG" />

Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Orn Kios was re-designated as the Anoat sector, and generations after that, the Anoat itself was further split into two parts, with Orn Kios becoming a part of the new Yarith sector.<ref name="GG" /> At some point by [[43 ABY]],<ref name="43 ABY">The section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' describing Orn Kios ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Orn Kios became a tourism destination, a fact that disgusted the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Ornki]] inhabitants.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
The inhabitants of Orn Kios, known as the Ornki,<ref name="TEA" /> resided in settlements that consisted of lightweight [[Wood/Legends|wood]]-and-canvas structures built on the planet's [[Lily/Legends|lily]] pads. The Ornki supported themselves through [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]]<ref name="GG" /> and resented their homeworld becoming a tourist attraction.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orn Kios was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
